tickets.title: Repeated names overwrite their total
tickets.description: When the same name appears on several input lines, tally prints only the last amount instead of the sum. Fix Run in main.go so repeated names add up.

tickets.title: Ignore comments and blank lines
tickets.description: tally fails with 'bad line' on blank lines and on lines starting with '#'. Make Run skip both, and keep summing the remaining lines.
criteria:
input "# note

alice 3
  
alice 2
" prints "alice: 5
" and returns no error
